name: skills
title_zh: 把任何人的思维方式蒸馏成一个能装的 skill
tagline_zh: 看到别人做事又快又稳，却说不清他脑子里的步骤？这个合集把「高手思路」拆成可安装的 skill，装完你也会了。
tagline_en: Ever watch an expert work and wonder what's going on in their head? This collection distills their thinking into.
why_zh: 不是教你怎么写 skill，而是直接给你一批「已拆解好的思维模板」。每个模板都来自真实工作流。
why_en: It doesn't teach you to write skills—it hands you ready-made thought templates extracted from real workflows. Install and run.
limit_zh: 只覆盖作者已收录的领域（如写作、编程、研究），未收录的思维模式需自行拆解；且 skill 依赖特定模型能力。
limit_en: Only covers domains the author has collected (writing, coding, research); uncollected patterns need DIY. Also relies on strong model.
